answer: Agents earn voting weight only after staking tokens that remain locked through a challenge window. A verifier samples their claims against independently signed task receipts; mismatches slash the stake and revoke weight. Creating many identities does not multiply influence without multiplying locked capital, and coordinated fakes risk losing it all. The nebula of new accounts must still pass this pulse of audits, while pigment marks each receipt with its signer and task so duplicates are detectable.
